note: Peak resident memory (MB) of the process of each kind of layer of F2a/F2b on BRA, the largest country (COMMAND 88/89; docs/_audit/memory_budget_88.md). `source` says how a figure was obtained: measured (this session, file or log), session_table (a measurement of the previous session reported in the table of COMMAND 88, not kept in a file) or budget_test (tests/unit/test_memory_budget.py, a raster of the size of BRA). The guard waits for peak_rss_mb + margin of free memory before a layer starts.

glo30.detail: worst block of the budget test; the complete BRA run (about 3 h) was not repeated

land_cover.detail: warp chunk of 1024 MB kept; nearest neighbour, no pixel changes with the chunk

land_cover_counts.detail: tile loop, partial run (stopped by the time limit); the final stretch (mask, write of 11 bands) measured alone peaks at 789 MB (2026-11-03)

population.detail: sum_to_grid, window of 64 MB, whole BRA, 84 s (2026-11-03); 551 MB with a 16 MB window
